2026-10-29 11:59:54.890643 | controller | Possible reasons for having these kinds of units are:

2026-10-29 11:59:54.890650 | controller |   .wants/, .requires/, or .upholds/ directory.
2026-10-29 11:59:54.890654 | controller | • A unit's purpose may be to act as a helper for some other unit which has
2026-10-29 11:59:54.890673 | controller |   a requirement dependency on it.
2026-10-29 11:59:54.890677 | controller | • A unit may be started when needed via activation (socket, path, timer,
2026-10-29 11:59:54.890680 | controller |   D-Bus, udev, scripted systemctl call, ...).
2026-10-29 11:59:54.890684 | controller | • In case of template units, the unit is meant to be enabled with some
2026-10-29 11:59:54.890688 | controller |   instance name specified.
